Apple has announced it will hold an iPhone launch event on September 9, with the theme "Awe dropping." Below are the ways to watch the September launch live stream, as well as a summary of the new products rumored to debut.

iPhone 18 Pro "Awe dropping" launch event: How to watch the September 9 live stream

Apple has confirmed the date of its most important event and product launch of the year, which will officially usher in the new era under CEO John Ternus.

The iPhone 18 Pro launch event will be held on September 9 at 1 PM Eastern Time / 10 AM Pacific Time.

Media have been invited to attend an in-person viewing event held at Apple Park, but the launch will be live-streamed to global audiences simultaneously. As is Apple's usual practice, it is expected to be broadcast in a pre-recorded video format.

You can watch the September "Awe dropping" launch event through the following methods:

  • Apple's YouTube channel (via this live stream link)
  • The Apple TV app on any device
  • Apple's official event website

What will be launched at the September event? iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and more

Apple is expected to bring a rich lineup of new products at its September 9 launch event. Here are all the rumored new products:

iPhone

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, A20 Pro processor, new color options, Dynamic Island updates, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Larger battery capacity, may exclusively feature specific camera functions
  • iPhone Ultra: The first foldable model

Apple Watch

  • Apple Watch Series 12: Upgraded S-series chip, more health features
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: Brand new health sensors, design updates, and more

AirPods

  • AirPods 5: Brand new model, available in active noise cancellation and non-active noise cancellation versions
  • There is no model equipped with a camera, contrary to earlier leaked rumors

Home products

  • Brand new Apple TV 4K: Supports Apple Intelligence, equipped with Siri AI features
  • HomePad: Smart home hub
  • HomePod mini 2: Upgraded chip and supports Siri AI

Among all the rumored products, iPhone and Apple Watch models are the most certain. The September launch event has always focused on these two product categories. However, according to Mark Gurman, AirPods 5 and new home products are also expected to debut at the same event.

If all the above products are launched on September 9, this will be a quite impressive "grand opening" for new CEO John Ternus.

What are you most looking forward to seeing at Apple's September launch event: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra, or other products? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
